messages:
Emma (CS): Quick check — Greenfield renewal coming up. They want to do an upfront deposit but procurement prefers netting the deposit against future invoices. Any legal/finance constraints?
Jordan (Finance): We can accept deposits but need a clear credit memo or offset clause. Netting requires the payee entity to match billing entity and a signed amendment.
Mike (Customer): Procurement prefers netting to avoid credit card ops. They'll only issue one PO for the year.
Katie (Legal): Netting is ok if contract language allows 'offset' or 'application of prepayment to future invoices'. I can draft a 1-paragraph amendment. Need payee entity and PO number.
Emma (CS): Payee is Greenfield Labs, Inc. — tax id 12-3456789 per onboarding doc.
Jordan (Finance): USD ACH to our primary account works, but if funds arrive to a different legal entity we need intercompany routing paperwork. Also: deposit application needs invoice references else we issue a credit memo on receipt.
Sam (SE): Note: renewal includes Dedicated capacity add-on (billing sku `dedicated-gpu-augment`). Does the deposit need to cover add-on amounts?
Jordan (Finance): It can cover base + add-ons. Best practice: PO/AMENDMENT line items reference the SKUs or the credit memo will be generic.
Emma (CS): Timeline: procurement wants to sign by EOD Friday. Can Legal push a draft today?
Katie (Legal): I can draft now. Confirm refund policy — customer ok with full refund within 30 days if funds unused?
Mike (Customer): Yes, that's acceptable.
DocuSign Bot: Document "Greenfield Renewal Amendment v1" uploaded by Katie (Legal).
Emma (CS): Two potential blockers: 1) procurement insists netting language is explicit in contract; 2) CFO who signs will be OOO Wed-Thu. Can we accept delegated signer?
Katie (Legal): We can accept delegated signer but need a written delegation email from procurement or an authorized signature matrix. Without that, CFO signature required per our policy.
Mike (Customer): I'll ask procurement to send a delegation email to confirm VP can sign if CFO is OOO.
Jordan (Finance): Once amendment signed and funds received, we will issue a credit memo referencing the PO and apply it to the next invoice after funds clear.
Emma (CS): @Jordan please confirm whether credit memo application is automated or manual so I can set expectations with customer.
Jordan (Finance): Manual for now — finance posts credit memo then applies it to invoices. Expect ~2 business days after funds clear.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0AB123 sent to Mike (Customer) and VP, status: sent.
Sam (SE): Small ops note — after amendment is active we'll schedule 20m to lock Dedicated resource pins; not dependent on billing but good to coordinate.
Emma (CS): Great. I'll update the renewal tracker with PO request and delegated-signer action. I'll ping procurement for PO number and copy legal once delegation email is received. :thumbsup:
